title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
reason: Frontier lab releasing a dedicated cybersecurity model — frontier-shifting and distinct from the recent Linux flaws post.

sources.summary: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

title: Standard Chartered and SBI back crypto insurer Soter as funding reaches $23.5 million
reason: Significant funding round with named institutional backers (Standard Chartered, SBI) plus large in-kind BTC/ETH commitments.

sources.summary: Soter also received backing of 500 BTC and 2000 ETH, worth another $43 million at current prices.
